correctness.rationale: Closed-simplex escort map and inverse verified algebraically; q≠1 optimization reduces to strict convex minimum for 0<q<1 or strict concave maximum for q>1. KKT adjacent-face inequalities reconstruct both exact cutoffs, including equality; q=1 uses strict Shannon concavity and infinite one-sided slope. Asymptotic expansion of the unique interior KKT root gives both the exponent and positive leading coefficient, with an explicit check at q=1/2. Embedded independent-to-the-proof finite calculations ran successfully; the proof rather than enumeration covers all orders and budgets.

value.rationale: For the first nonbinary capacity profile, an exact three-phase benchmark classification resolves when maximum theoretical biodiversity deliberately gives an admissible species zero abundance. The critical onset law identifies a nontrivial order-sensitive regularity transition at q=1/2, a quantitative consequence not available from stating only the generic truncated stationary power law. This is a motivated, complete classification of a natural small ecological benchmark, with clear interpretation and limits.
